_README: MARKER-ONLY. Never fetched by the student's browser until a teacher/marker PDF is generated. Never render any of this on the student-facing page. See CLAUDE.md section 5's assessment-security amendment.

markingScheme.criterion: Quotes the Spanish words of one real task from their own Record (e.g. 'Nosotros somos', 'la chica alta') that they got wrong or needed two tries for.
markingScheme.accept: Any task in the student's own Record with Tries 2 or Right = No; if the Record is perfect, any task from it. Accents not required.
markingScheme.insufficient: Describing a rule in general with no task or Spanish words taken from their Record.

markingScheme.criterion: States the correct rule behind that task (possessive matches the thing owned: mi/mis, nuestro/nuestra/nuestros/nuestras; location uses estar, description uses ser; adjectives agree; a Spain vs Latin America difference such as piso/casa, coche/carro).
markingScheme.accept: Any correct rule that fits the quoted task, in English or Spanish, in the student's own words.
markingScheme.insufficient: 'I got it wrong' or 'it changes' with no stated reason or pattern.

markingScheme.criterion: Writes one new, correct Spanish example that follows the stated rule.
markingScheme.accept: Any grammatically correct Unit 1 example (minor accent slips allowed if the form is clear), different from the quoted task.
markingScheme.insufficient: Repeating the quoted task, or a new example with a wrong verb form or ending.

markingScheme.criterion: Sentences 1 and 4: correct SER description of a family member and of a room, with adjectives agreeing in gender and number (mi madre es alta; la cocina es moderna).
markingScheme.accept: Any correct ser form and agreeing adjective in both sentences. Accents optional.
markingScheme.insufficient: Estar used for a lasting description, or non-agreeing adjectives ('mi madre es alto').

markingScheme.criterion: Sentences 2 and 3: a correct possessive (mi/mis/nuestro/nuestra...) matching the thing owned AND a correct estar location sentence with a valid preposition (al lado de, a la izquierda de, a la derecha de, en).
markingScheme.accept: e.g. 'Mis hermanos son altos' / 'La lámpara está al lado de la cama'.

markingScheme.criterion: Sentence 5 and English line: a correct Spain vs Latin America pair (piso/casa/depa, coche/carro/auto, ordenador/computadora) AND an accurate English reason contrasting ser (description/identity) with estar (location/state).
markingScheme.accept: Any correct pair and a correct reason.
markingScheme.insufficient: Wrong region, or an explanation that does not distinguish ser from estar.

criteria.source: = the Explain question's 3-point marking scheme above, one-to-one. Do not award these marks a second time here.

levels.descriptor: None of the three analytic points achieved: no real task quoted from the Record, no correct rule, and no correct new example.
Achieves only ONE of the three: quotes a real task from their Record OR states a correct rule OR gives a correct new example.
Achieves TWO of the three analytic points.
Quotes a real task from their own Record, states the correct rule, and gives a correct new Spanish example — all three analytic points present.

criteria.source: = the Apply question's 3-point marking scheme above, one-to-one. Do not award these marks a second time here.

levels.descriptor: None of the three analytic points achieved: no correct ser descriptions, no correct possessive + estar location, and no correct regional pair with ser/estar reason.
Achieves only ONE of the three analytic points.
Achieves TWO of the three analytic points.
Correct ser descriptions with agreement, a correct possessive and estar location sentence, and a correct regional pair plus an accurate ser/estar reason — all three analytic points present.

criteria.source: Assessed holistically across BOTH the Explain and Apply answers together — independent of, and never overlapping with, the content marks in use_of_evidence and spanish_use above.

levels.descriptor: Too unclear or incomplete for the meaning to be followed reliably.
Main meaning understandable, but organisation, vocabulary or precision cause some difficulty.
Clear and logical, uses Unit 1 vocabulary, and is easy to follow. Minor spelling or accent slips that do not harm meaning are not penalised.

markingInstructions: Mark ONLY the two constructed responses (Explain, Apply). Award marks point-by-point using each question's markingScheme: each point is worth the marks stated and is independent unless it names a dependsOn point (award it only if that earlier point was also awarded). use_of_evidence's 3 marks ARE the Explain scheme's 3 points and spanish_use's 3 marks ARE the Apply scheme's 3 points; award each set once, not twice. communication is a separate, holistic 2 marks across both answers. Copy auto_marked_score into knowledge_accuracy. Use the student's logged Record (nivel/tarea/respuesta/correcto/intentos) to verify any task they quote. Students are true beginners (A1): accept valid alternative wording and do not penalise a missing accent unless it changes the meaning. Total is out of 15 (7 auto + 3 + 3 + 2). Report total, percentage, one strength, one correction, one next step, under 80 words.
